brief: Cybersecurity platform for small and mid-sized businesses (UK): email filtering, phishing simulations, staff training. Stat: 9 out of 10 cyberattacks start with an email. Target: SMB owners and IT managers. Channel: LinkedIn + YouTube pre-roll. CTA: free inbox security audit at sentinel-secure.co.uk.
angle: Story: an inbox, a convincing fake “overdue invoice” email, the cursor hesitates… Sentinel catches it.
